items.title: Send a problem
items.description: Set Competitive Companion’s Custom Port to 10045, click its button on a problem page and run the samples with F12.

groups.title: Import with your template
groups.description: The local listener receives problems on port 10045. Samples go under ~/Code/cph/, with template.cpp and template.js supplying source and naming rules.

groups.title: Run sample tests
groups.description: Press F9 to compile, F10 to compile and run the first sample or F12 to test all samples.
